title: NHC Lifer
intro: Make allies. Keep secrets. Make every life count.
description: Take your Minecraft survival instincts into Boogie, Hunger Games and Soulbound. Hide a secret objective, race the shrinking border or put your life in another NotHermit’s hands. Every encounter could change the game.

menu.title: Your game, one command away
menu.description: Type /NHCLife in Minecraft chat to open the player menu. Check your lives, read the current rules, and find the options available to you.

items.title: Rules and status
items.text: Read the current game settings. Starting lives, opening protection, inventory retention and other options can vary between games.

items.title: Your Boogie Assignment
items.text: If you are a Boogie, check your remaining deadline and private bounty target here.

items.title: Your Soul Bond
items.text: In Soulbound, check your current partner in /NHCLife > Your Soul Bond. If identities are hidden for the game, the menu keeps your partner a mystery. Before opening protection ends, you are not yet bonded.

items.title: My Secret Task
items.text: In Boogie, view your private objective, use Reroll Task, and report PASS or FAIL when review opens. This menu also provides tasks in Soulbound games where they are enabled.

items.title: Transfer a life
items.text: Gift a life in Boogie or Soulbound through the confirmation menu. You can also type /giveaheart playername.

items.title: Watch Game / Return to Limbo
items.text: Guests and eliminated players can watch active play in Spectator mode or return to the safe limbo hangout. Living participants stay in the game until a break or session end.

modes.title: Boogie
modes.tagline: Trust is precious. So are your lives.
modes.description: Build, explore and form alliances in a survival game where a friend may secretly need a kill. Balance your remaining lives against private bounties and secret objectives. The last participant with lives wins.

sections.title: Survive the Boogie
items: After opening PvP protection ends, eligible online participants may be secretly selected as Boogies. Watch your private messages and Your Boogie Assignment in the menu.

As a Boogie, earn a qualifying player kill before your displayed deadline to clear the assignment. Another Boogie can be your victim. Missing the deadline costs a life; dying also clears your assignment.
A private bounty names a particular player. Killing that target clears your assignment and earns one extra life. Killing another eligible participant still clears it, without the bonus.

New bounties do not target red-life players. A Boogie may receive no bounty if there are too few eligible targets; they can still clear the assignment with a qualifying kill. A target disconnecting does not reroll the bounty.

Once all current Boogies have completed or lost their assignments, new Boogies can be chosen. If you are a Boogie, logging out does not stop your countdown. The countdown stops during breaks and whenever gameplay is paused. Any assignments still active at the end of a session are cleared.

sections.title: Know when you can fight
items: PvP is blocked during the opening safe period. Wait for the in-game announcement before fighting.
On your last life, your name turns red. You receive special red-life tasks and, once opening protection ends, you can kill other players without losing a life for unauthorized murder.
If both killer and victim have more than one life and neither is a current Boogie, the killer loses a life for unauthorized murder. The victim also loses a life from the death.

Deaths cost one life. At zero lives you are eliminated. The tab list shows your life total. Names change color with lives: 5+ dark green, 4 lime green, 3 yellow, 2 gold, 1 red, and 0 gray. Guests are also gray.

sections.title: Keep your task secret
items: Open My Secret Task to read your private role and objective. Expect resource challenges, trades, builds, exploration and objectives involving other players.

Complete the actual objective without having it correctly identified by another player before open review. A discovered objective must be reported FAIL, even if you completed it. Report honestly: this is an honor system.
One-life players receive red objectives involving traps, tricks, theft or sabotage. Gaining another life returns you to normal objectives.
Need a different objective? My Secret Task > Reroll Task gives one confirmed reroll per session during active play, before reporting. A new task round or reconnect does not refresh that allowance.

At hourly and final task-review gatherings, follow the on-screen instructions and assemble within 50 blocks of game spawn. PvP and damage are blocked during gathering. Wait until review is open to reveal your task.
Explain your task, choose PASS or FAIL in My Secret Task, and confirm. Stay within the 50-block area until review ends. Being offline, outside the area or leaving a task unreported results in FAIL.

PASS earns one life. FAIL costs one life, except that a red-life player never loses their last life for a failed task. Results settle together when review finishes, then new tasks are assigned if play continues.

sections.title: Give an ally another chance
items: Use Transfer a life or /giveaheart playername to open a confirmation. Both players must be online, living participants in active Boogie gameplay.
You can successfully give one life per session and must keep your final life. Gifts cannot revive eliminated players. Receiving lives can take you above the starting total.

modes.title: Hunger Games
modes.tagline: Gear up. Keep moving. Outlast everyone.
modes.description: Race to gather supplies, choose your fights and survive as the world border shrinks. The safe ground gets smaller, the stakes get higher, and the last participant with lives takes the win.

sections.title: Rules of survival
items: Use the protected opening to gather resources and prepare. PvP becomes available when the safe period ends.
When opening protection ends, the hunt begins. Choose your fights, outsmart your opponents and make every life count as you battle to be the last survivor.

Watch the visible world border and move inward as it shrinks. Staying outside the game-world border causes damage. A bed or respawn anchor left outside it will no longer return you there; you will be redirected to game spawn.
Every death costs a life; reaching zero eliminates you. Check Rules and status for the starting lives and inventory rules of your game.
The game ends when one participant has lives remaining. If nobody has lives left, it is a draw. An offline participant with lives still counts.

modes.title: Soulbound
modes.tagline: Two NotHermits. One health bar. What could possibly go wrong?
modes.description: Your partner’s daring adventure is suddenly your problem too. Share the danger, share the healing and try to keep each other alive as soul bonds bring NotHermits together. When partners change, yesterday’s rival could become the person you need most.

sections.title: Your life is in their hands
items: Use the protected opening to prepare. Bonds form when the safe period ends, and each session begins with a fresh, unpaired opening.

Once bonded, you and your partner share health—even across long distances and different dimensions. Damage to either of you lowers the shared health; healing either of you helps both. Your own armor and defenses determine the damage from a hit you take.
Food, absorption hearts, equipment and inventories remain your own. Keep yourself supplied as well as watching out for your partner.

If either partner dies, both die and each loses one life. Your remaining life totals are individual, so one partner may be eliminated before the other. An ordinary death does not break the bond if you both still have lives.
A Totem of Undying held by either online partner can save the pair from a lethal hit, consuming one totem. Keep it in your main hand or offhand when danger is close.
Once opening protection ends, PvP is on. Even partners can hurt each other, so watch that sword swing. Coordinate your fights: the risk belongs to both of you.

sections.title: New bond, new adventure
items: When partner rotation is enabled, bonds change during active play. Watch the in-game warning and check Your Soul Bond after the change. Rotation pauses whenever gameplay pauses.
Partner identities may be revealed or hidden for your game. With hidden bonds, shared damage and healing might be your clues. A little detective work could save your life.
Pairing can use the lower of the two players’ current health, their average health or full health, depending on the game settings. A new partner does not always mean a fresh health bar.

An odd number of survivors leaves one NotHermit unbound, with ordinary individual health. When bonds rotate, the unbound turn is shared around. If your partner is eliminated, you become unbound; two unbound survivors can be linked together.
Logging out does not sever a soul bond. Shared damage and linked deaths can still affect you while you are offline.

sections.title: Keep your partner—and your chances—alive
items: Use /NHCLife > Transfer a life or /giveaheart playername to gift a life. Both players must be online, living participants in active gameplay. You can give once per session and must keep your last life.
Life gifts change individual life totals, not the shared health bar. They cannot revive eliminated players.
The last surviving bonded pair wins together. A lone survivor wins individually; no survivors means a draw.

Secret tasks are off by default in Soulbound. If your game enables them, use My Secret Task and follow the task-review notices. Rewards and penalties affect your own life total; a task penalty does not trigger a linked death.
Check Rules and status for your game’s starting lives, inventory-on-death rule and bond settings. Then make a plan together—preferably before one of you decides to hug a creeper.

items.title: Be there for the start
items.text: The roster is set during the first session’s opening safe period. Once it closes, new arrivals are guests for that game. In later sessions, rostered survivors who miss the safe-period deadline lose one life, but can still join later with any lives remaining.

items.title: Check what is at stake
items.text: Each new game starts with empty player inventories. Read Rules and status for the current inventory-on-death setting and follow the host’s start instructions.

items.title: Follow the game notices
items.text: Breaks move players to protected limbo, then living players return to play. Follow the in-game announcements for protection, gatherings and when gameplay resumes.

items.title: Stay for the spectacle
items.text: Out of lives or joining as a guest? Open /NHCLife and choose Watch Game to spectate active play, or Return to Limbo to hang out safely.

closing: Choose your allies carefully. Your next life could depend on them.

join.title: Your next adventure starts on NHC
join.description: Ready, NotHermit? Use /lifer on NHC (NotHermitCraft) to get to the games. Once you are there, /NHCLife opens your player menu.

community.title: NotHermits make the mayhem
community.description: The best moments do not come from a menu. They come from you. NHC Lifer comes alive when NotHermits get involved: a questionable alliance, an ambitious scheme, a surprise adventure, or a deal that is definitely, probably, completely trustworthy.

items.title: Be the plot twist
items.text: Make the first move. Propose a trade, recruit an ally, build something worth visiting or invite someone on a risky expedition. Give other NotHermits a reason to leave their hideouts.

items.title: Make room for more mischief
items.text: Bring someone into the plan, especially a NotHermit you have not played with before. A busy world starts with players making things happen together.

items.title: Play for the story
items.text: Chase the win, but enjoy the spectacular failures too. A backfired scheme can become the best story of the night. Keep rivalries playful and give everyone something to laugh about afterward.

items.title: Keep the adventure moving
items.text: Do not wait for someone else to make it interesting. Show up, get curious and bring an idea. Follow the game rules, keep the fun shared, and help turn an ordinary encounter into a NotHermitCraft legend.

items.title: Rivals in the game. Friends, always.
items.text: Steal the victory, spring the trap, betray the alliance—but keep the rivalry in the game. There are friends behind every player name. Celebrate each other’s clever plays, laugh off the setbacks, and finish with the same friendships you started with. The best ending is everyone wanting to play again.
